description: Generate a JUnit 5 test class: real assertions from {input, expected|throws} cases, @Disabled tests for described cases, optional Mockito extension

testCases.description: Test cases. Either a description string (generated as a pending test) or {name, input: [args...], expected} / {name, input, throws: true | "message"} for a real assertion.

throws.description: true, or a substring of the expected error message
